scheme_name: Namami Gange – Ganga Rejuvenation Innovation Fund
overview: The Namami Gange – Ganga Rejuvenation Innovation Fund is a financial mechanism under the National Mission for Clean Ganga (NMCG) aimed at supporting innovative technologies and solutions for the rejuvenation of the Ganga River. It focuses on funding projects related to pollution abatement, water quality monitoring, and sustainable interventions along the river basin. The fund is part of the broader Namami Gange Programme, which integrates institutional development and infrastructure investments to achieve a clean and ecologically healthy Ganga.
geographic_scope: Pan-India (Ganga River Basin states: Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand, West Bengal)
objectives: Support innovative technologies for Ganga rejuvenation
Promote research and development in water quality management
Encourage private sector participation in pollution abatement
Fund pilot projects for sustainable river conservation
Strengthen institutional capacity for monitoring and evaluation
Facilitate technology transfer and scaling of successful models
Ensure ecological and economic sustainability of interventions
eligibility: Eligible entities include startups, MSMEs, research institutions, NGOs, and technology providers proposing innovative solutions for Ganga rejuvenation. Projects must align with the objectives of the Namami Gange Programme and demonstrate technical feasibility, environmental impact, and scalability. Preference is given to solutions addressing sewage treatment, industrial effluent control, solid waste management, and real-time water quality monitoring.
benefits: Financial support for project implementation, access to NMCG’s network of experts and institutions, technical guidance, pilot-scale testing opportunities, potential for scaling up successful models, and integration into national river conservation strategies. Non-financial benefits include visibility under the Namami Gange brand, collaboration with state SPMGs, and support for regulatory compliance.
financial_support: The fund provides grants and/or seed funding to selected innovative projects. The quantum of support is determined based on project scope, stage of development, and expected outcomes. Funding is disbursed in tranches linked to project milestones, subject to technical and financial appraisal by NMCG or its designated agencies.
application_process: 1. Submit a detailed project proposal through the NMCG portal or designated channel. 2. Proposal undergoes preliminary screening for eligibility and alignment with Namami Gange objectives. 3. Shortlisted applications are evaluated by a technical committee for innovation, feasibility, and impact. 4. Selected applicants are invited for presentation or detailed discussion. 5. Final approval is granted by the NMCG steering committee. 6. Funds are released in installments based on project progress and utilization certificates.
required_documents: Letters of support or partnership (if any)
Environmental and social impact assessment (if applicable)
implementing_agency: National Mission for Clean Ganga (NMCG), Ministry of Jal Shakti, Department of Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation
caveats: Funding is subject to availability of budget and approval by competent authority
Projects must not duplicate existing government-funded initiatives
Intellectual property rights must be clearly defined and shared as per NMCG guidelines
Beneficiaries must submit periodic progress reports and utilization certificates
Funding may be withdrawn for non-compliance or delays in implementation
